summary: Read README.md, observed Git HEAD and Codex version, and computed the README SHA-256 from its bytes. Orca mailbox access failed with runtime_unavailable and the live preamble did not supply a run_id. Probe completion is blocked pending available Orca runtime and actual run_id.
blocked_reason: orca orchestration check exited 1 with runtime_unavailable: Could not connect to the running Orca app. The live preamble supplied task_id and dispatch_id but no run_id, and ORCA_RUN_ID was unset; run_id is null rather than invented.
